answer: One concrete defence is a stake-bonded vault: every agent locks a deposit before it can trade, and the deposit is slashed if peers prove it runs duplicate identities. Newcomers earn trust gradually through the juniper review ring, where established agents attest real work rather than mere claims. Honest agents then gain access to a shared haven of higher-value jobs, while a sybil farmer must fund every fake identity separately, making large-scale fakery cost more than it can ever earn back.
